text:
kate_sales: Heads-up: CapitalOne-ish signed a 30d POC. HIPAA scope, steady ~2k qps embeddings + ~1k qps chat gen, plus 3 predictable market-open spikes to ~42k qps for ~2-4m. They want recommended reserved commit, autoscale/burst plan, preheat runbook, and called-out items for the security questionnaire.
omar_se: congrats. Are spikes cronified?
kate_sales: yes — they gave windows (will share exact cron).
omar_se: good. short summary recommendation: commit small baseline for steady-state (2 A100-equiv + 1 T4-equiv) and a burst pool that can spin to ~22 A100-equiv for the spike. Use preheat T-15m, spin burst T-5m.
zane_eng: quick sizing notes: 1 x A100-80GB fp16 ≈ 1.5k qps gen (batching), T4-equiv ≈ 3k qps embeddings. For their steady mix baseline=2 A100-equiv + 1 T4-equiv. To reach 42k qps need ~22 A100-equiv. We'll rely on fast scale and burst credits.
maya_sre: ops checklist: 1) preheat KV/prefix caches at T-15m, 2) rehearsals (2 runs), 3) autoscale caps + fallback model when queue depth > threshold, 4) AZ placement and private networking. Also exportable audit log per preheat event.
rachel_solutions: POC runbook outline: preheat (T-15m), enable batching/prewarm, spin burst (T-5m), route to dedicated cluster, fallback to quantized-8bit when p99 latency > target. Include CLI example for customer to trigger preheat.
zane_eng: autoscale snippet for runbook to copy-paste:
```yaml
autoscale:
  baseline_reserved: "2"         # A100-equivalents
  baseline_embeddings: "1"      # T4-equivalents
  burst_pool_max: "22"          # A100-equivalents
  preheat_minutes: "15"
  spinup_buffer_minutes: "5"
  scale_up_threshold: "0.7"
  scale_down_minutes: "10"
  fallback_model: "gen-8bit-compact-v1"
  kv_cache_prefixes: ["market_open_v1"]
```

lee_fin: pricing: recommend hybrid for POC — small committed baseline (2 GPUs) + burst-credit bundle (blocks of A100-min). I'll post a stub estimate (prorated GPU-month + burst credits) by EOD.
maya_sre: security flags to surface in questionnaire: customer-managed KMS for PHI, VPC peering or PrivateLink, SOC2 report, SCIM/SAML for provisioning, egress Allowlist, and retention window for audit logs. For POC we can do token-scrubbing but KMS + audit retention likely required.
rachel_solutions: also add operational checklist for preheat audit line: `preheat:event_id=XYZ started_by=... profile=... duration=900s targets=...`. Customer should be able to trigger preheat from their side with an audit-id.
infra_bot: infra-bot: reserved-pool "cap-one-sim-poc" requested (baseline=2 A100-equiv, embeddings=1 T4-equiv, burst_cap=22 A100-equiv) by zane_eng at 2025-02-14T09:12:00Z.
omar_se: next steps: 1) confirm cron windows with customer, 2) agree baseline + burst-credit bundle for POC, 3) schedule two rehearsals and capture p99/queue metrics, 4) collect questionnaire answers (KMS/SOC2/SCIM). I'll draft the runbook and paste link here.
kate_sales: I'll send the proposal + questionnaire now and ask if they prefer us or them triggering preheat. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
